description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus for WP6: references p.m to members of owned ports, forwarded boundaries, child ports, provided attributes and events in operation bodies, guards and initializers (2.2: unknown local values), locals, parameters and bindings named like ports, required attributes with zero or two owners, connection policies on events, latest attributes and requests, atLeastOnce idempotency on component and package connections, a redefined connection, attribute delivery with latency, faults and maxAge, and case scripts that receive at actor ports and read occurrence.port.member. In 2.3 a port whose attribute members declare initial values opts in to sampled reads and a connection may carry member policies (WP6-G01, WP6-G02); none of these sources uses them, so their diagnostics, ASTs and runs must stay as recorded. Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar. Their diagnostics (with related information), normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp6.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.

models.name: s1 p.m of a required attribute of an owned port in an operation body, unowned: unknown local value and owner errors
s2 p.m of an owned attribute that also has a receive owner
s3 p.m in a receive guard and in state guards
s4 p.m in attribute initializers, a const attribute and a local initializer
s5 p.m of a forwarded boundary and of a child port
s6 p.m of a provided attribute and of an event member of an owned port
s7 a local, a parameter and a binding named like a port, with fields (valid, runs)
s8 required attributes with no owner and with two owners
s9 atLeastOnce connection with a non-idempotent and an idempotent provided operation
s10 one connection policy for an event queue, a latest attribute and a request timeout (runs)
s11 a redefined connection with another policy (runs)
s12 attribute delivery with latency and faults: replaced, dropped, duplicated and aged values (runs)
s13 a case script that reads occurrence.port.member and receives it
s14 a package connection with a policy, and atLeastOnce at package level
s15 a case script that receives on a port with a policy and test reads of the subject (runs)
s16 completion-like guards in 2.2: a self-polling timer machine reading another operation's attribute (runs)
